title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the length of the tree array.
Line 2: n space-separated integers in level order, where -1 marks a missing node. The children of index i are at indices 2*i+1 and 2*i+2.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum depth (number of nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path).
constraints:
1 <= n <= 2047
Each value is -1 (no node) or between 0 and 10^4.
A node's children are only present when the node itself is present.

examples.explanation: The longest path is 3 -> 20 -> 15 (or 3 -> 20 -> 7), which has 3 nodes.
